notes: findCorruptBackups (lines 19-33) filters the app directory's contents to names with the `server_config_swift.json.corrupt-` prefix, then sorts newest-creation-date first, falling back to `.distantPast` when a creation date can't be read (line 29-30). This crate has no filesystem creation-date metadata to read (`FileSystem`, P3.4), so it sorts on the nanosecond suffix `corrupt_backup_path` itself embeds when writing each backup -- numerically equivalent for anything this crate wrote. A suffix that doesn't parse as a number sorts last, mirroring the `.distantPast` fallback. `server_config_swift.json` itself (no `.corrupt-` suffix) and an unrelated file are excluded, matching the source's `hasPrefix` filter.
